name: three.ws
description: three.ws: the 3D agent economy. Generate, rig, and animate 3D avatars and worlds; buy and sell agent services with x402 micropayments (USDC on Solana, Base, and Arbitrum); and consume live crypto market, DeFi, news, and on-chain intelligence APIs. Machine-readable paid-service catalog at https://three.ws/.well-known/x402.json.

extensions.description: Optional. Activate it to call the pay-per-call skills: the first call returns the payment requirements and the retry with a signed payment payload settles and runs. Free skills never need it.

bearer.description: Optional three.ws API key (sk_live_...) or session token. Anonymous calls work and are rate limited per IP; a valid key is limited per account instead and raises the search result cap. An invalid key is rejected with 401.

skills.name: Generate a 3D Model
skills.description: Turn a short text description of one object or character into a textured 3D model (GLB). The task is created in the working state and completes with the GLB, a browser viewer link and an augmented-reality link; poll it with GetTask (tasks/get on 0.3). Free, no account needed.
examples: Generate a 3D model of a small ceramic robot figurine
Make a low-poly wooden treasure chest

skills.name: Validate and Inspect a glTF/GLB Model
skills.description: Fetch a public glTF or GLB model, run the Khronos glTF-Validator on it, and return the error, warning, info and hint counts, structural stats (vertices, triangles, meshes, materials, textures, animations, skins, extensions) and prioritized optimization recommendations. Free, no account needed.

skills.name: Search Public 3D Avatars
skills.description: Search the public three.ws gallery of 3D avatars and characters by keyword or tag. Returns each match with its name, description, tags, GLB URL and page link. Up to 10 results anonymously, up to 50 with a bearer API key.
examples: Search the gallery for a knight character

skills.name: Inspect glTF/GLB (A2A, pay per call)
skills.description: Pay-per-call glTF/GLB inspector over the a2a-x402 extension. Activate the extension with the A2A-Extensions header: the first call returns the payment requirements, and the retry with a signed payment payload settles and returns the glTF-Transform inspection report as a task artifact.
examples: Vet this GLB before I mint it

skills.name: Paid x402 Service Catalog
skills.description: 77 pay-per-call services settled via x402 (USDC on Solana, Base, and Arbitrum): market-data (27), 3d (19), agent-infra (18), launch (5), trust (4), payments (4). Every service is listed with price, input schema, and output example in the machine-readable discovery document: fetch it, pick a service, and pay the 402 challenge.
examples: Fetch https://three.ws/.well-known/x402.json and list the market-data services
Pay the 402 challenge on /api/x402/token-intel to get a token signal
